subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron run status across persistence, Gateway protocol, CLI/UI, hooks, and Plugin SDK, or should yielded waiting remain an internal lifecycle state mapped onto the existing public status contract?
rationale: Either representation can prevent premature completion, but they impose different compatibility, upgrade, and operator-automation contracts that code inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Model yielded waiting internally and preserve the existing public cron status union until a separate API design is approved.

options.title: Adopt public deferred status
options.body: Keep the new status and require documented semantics plus fresh-install and upgrade compatibility proof for all consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Model yielded waiting internally and preserve the existing public cron status union until a separate API design is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing yielded-run lifecycle precedent traces to this owner, making them the strongest available decision route for whether that state becomes public API.
